senses.gloss: עַוֵּי (cmp. צָוַח) to cry; Yoma 77ᵃ ע׳ ע׳ וליכא דאשגח ביה (missing in later eds.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) he cried and cried, and none minded him.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 71b:9">Yeb. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>היכא דלא מְעַוֵּי</he> if the infant (on putting its head forth the first time) did not cry.
<cite ref="Shabbat 134a:14">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>האי ינוקא דלא מעוי</he> if an infant does not cry (breathe).
<cite ref="Sotah 12a:19">Sot. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>כי היכי … ומעוי בהדייהו</he> in order that it should hear them and cry with them; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chullin 53a:16">Ḥull. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>איהו קא מְעַוַּאי</he> when he (the lion) roars.
